newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares hit record on Monday, seen up.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares hit record on Monday, seen up.

text.p: Russian shares broke records on Monday after a holiday weekend, supported chiefly by investors seeking shares in UES after global depositary receipts in the national electric company began trading abroad.
** Russian Trading System 22-share index rose 6.9 percent on close on Thursday, the previous day of trade, to record 349.27.
** UES closed at $0.3140, off a record of over 34 cents set during the morning and up on Thursday's $0.2798.
** Total reported turnover was a healthy $50.0 million and traders said UES was the volume leader. Traders said UES led shares up and that further market-wide growth was probable on Tuesday.
"The market seems rather strong to me," said Aton trader Alexander Bobolev. He said an overhang of buying orders from Western investors over the long weekend had supported prices.

"There is a tendency towards rising prices, but it is unaggressive," said Regent Securities senior trader Dmitry Starenko who added that UES had achieved a new level but the general market had not materially changed.
Shares in oil company LUKoil rose to from $14.70, regional utility Mosenergo rose to $1.377 from $1.359 and telecom Rostelekom rose to $3.96 from $3.85.
